description: This file contains unit tests for the Accounts module in SuiteCRM, testing methods such as getProductsServicesPurchasedQuery, get_summary_text, get_contacts, and others, utilizing PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: AccountTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Accounts module, utilizing SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase as base.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test, setting up global user and configuration.

methods.name: testgetProductsServicesPurchasedQuery
methods.description: Tests the method getProductsServicesPurchasedQuery of the Account bean with and without an account ID.

methods.name: testAccount
methods.description: Verifies instantiation of Account object and its properties.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Tests retrieval of account summary text with and without setting the name attribute.

methods.name: testget_contacts
methods.description: Tests the get_contacts method to ensure it returns an array.

methods.name: testremove_redundant_http
methods.description: Verifies that remove_redundant_http method executes without exceptions.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Tests get_list_view_data method, but is marked as incomplete due to PHP 7.1 compatibility issues.

methods.name: testbuild_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Verifies the build_generic_where_clause method with string and numeric input.

methods.name: testset_notification_body
methods.description: Tests if set_notification_body correctly populates a Sugar_Smarty object.

methods.name: testbean_implements
methods.description: Checks the bean_implements method for valid and invalid feature support.

methods.name: testget_unlinked_email_query
methods.description: Tests the get_unlinked_email_query method with and without a filtering parameter.
